projects.title: Projects
projects.p1_desc: Final project for hospital protocol management with Power Apps and SharePoint.
projects.p1_why: Academic project focused on processes, data modeling, integration and source-level access control.
projects.p1_problem: Employees needed to quickly reach the right protocol (and the current version) without manual searching through documents.
projects.p1_solution: Catalog design, profile/service filtering, read tracking and version handling.
projects.p1_result: Interactive web demo and synthetic Excel workbook available. The equivalent Power Apps and SharePoint setup is documented.
projects.p2_desc: Card-deck catalog built with C#/.NET and Avalonia, with local JSON persistence.
projects.p2_why: I practiced data binding, commands and separation of model, view and logic.
projects.p2_problem: Practice desktop catalog management and persistence.
projects.p2_solution: MVVM, record navigation, creation and deletion.
projects.p2_result: Code and screenshots available. Editing, filters and full functional validation remain pending.
projects.p3_desc: Android contact book for adding, viewing and deleting contacts with images.
projects.p3_why: I practiced forms, lists and asynchronous operations with a remote database.
projects.p3_problem: Keep a contact list with phone numbers, birthdays and images.
projects.p3_solution: Kotlin, RecyclerView, validation and Firebase Realtime Database.
projects.p3_result: Creation, viewing and deletion implemented. Authentication, per-user data and editing remain pending.
projects.p4_desc: Collaborative web bingo with a shared board and personal boards.
projects.p4_why: Previously called “BingoEnvidiosos”. Great practice for real-time sync, shared state and multi-user UX.
projects.p4_problem: Coordinating a shared board across multiple users in real time without desync or page reloads.
projects.p4_solution: HTML, CSS and JavaScript with shared state in Firebase Realtime Database.
projects.p4_result: Evidence: real-time multi-user project (repo includes features and structure).
projects.p5_desc: Search and information extraction automation with Java and Selenium.
projects.p5_why: I learned element selection, navigation and waits.
projects.p5_problem: Practice automated navigation and collection of web results.
projects.p5_solution: Java program with WebDriver, waits, screenshots and CSV export.
projects.p5_result: Code available. JUnit, Page Objects, CI and Allure are not implemented in this repository.
projects.p6_desc: A set of Kotlin mini-projects to master key areas: multimedia, concurrency and persistence.
projects.p6_why: Mini-case format: a real problem, a concrete solution and a clear competency signal.
projects.p6_problem: Learning key Kotlin/Android concepts fast without getting stuck in huge slow-to-iterate projects.
projects.p6_result: Evidence: 3 repos with features + screenshots/docs per mini-case.
projects.p7_desc: 100% local pipeline to turn PDFs into a searchable RAG knowledge base (answers with citations) and automate ingestion + daily digests with n8n.
projects.p7_why: I integrate JWT authentication, persistence and semantic search. Answers may contain errors; sources help users review them.
projects.p7_problem: When you pile up PDFs (guides, notes, specs), finding reliable answers is slow and hard to trace.
projects.p7_solution: Local stack with n8n workflows, Spring Boot API (JWT), Postgres + pgvector, and Ollama for embeddings + RAG returning `sources[]` with page/snippet evidence.
projects.p7_result: Evidence: `/ask` returns an answer + cited sources/pages; WF1 ingests PDFs from `inbox/` and WF2 writes daily digests to `outbox/` (docs + Postman collection).
projects.p8_desc: Personal system for habits + gamification (XP/HP/streaks) + daily logging + digital detox, with Notion as the base and automation on top.
projects.p8_why: A big end-to-end project: I connect real components (Notion + Make + ntfy + Android) and document everything so it stays maintainable and robust.
projects.p8_problem: I wanted a single system to track habits and digital detox without paid apps or daily manual work.
projects.p8_solution: Notion data model + daily Make scenario for streaks/XP/HP + push notifications via ntfy + Android Detox app exporting CSV by app/category.
projects.p8_result: Repository documenting Notion, Make and the Android app. Costs and limits depend on usage and service plans.
